translations.web: Jonathan called David, and Jonathan showed him all those things. Then Jonathan brought David to Saul, and he was in his presence, as before.
translations.bsb: So Jonathan summoned David and told him all these things. Then Jonathan brought David to Saul, and David was with Saul as before.
